text:
zoe: WFH update: set up a temporary desk in the hallway because the cat chose my office as a nap zone. router lives on the shoe rack now. photo: https://imgur.com/a/hallway-wfh (1 pic)
arthur: Shoe-rack routing is a vibe. does the router get stomped during rush hour? :running_shoe:
zoe: so far so good. using a short USB-C cable to power it from the pantry shelf. yes, it looks ridiculous.
cass: Pro tip: enable band steering on the AP so your devices pick the 5GHz away from the toaster/sneaker area.
pete: if it drops mid-standup, blame the laundry timer. true story.
zoe: ran a quick speedcheck while on a call, results below:
```
$ speedtest-cli --simple
Ping: 32.4 ms
Download: 42.7 Mbit/s
Upload: 9.2 Mbit/s
```
zoe: fine for audio + shared slides, shaky for multi-person video.
arthur: poll time: worst temporary router spot you've used? 1) Under pillow 2) Shoe rack 3) Bathroom shelf 4) Behind mountain of laundry
cass: 4, definitely 4. laundry is the silent killer.
pete: 2 for me. shoes are judgy but reliable.
ops-bot: Reminder: file an ISP ticket with /ispsupport if speed < 20Mbps or packet loss > 1%.
zoe: not filing, will survive until cat relocates. will post after-pic if it gets more ridiculous. :camera_with_flash:
